_cost_note: This tool meters per keyword on YOUR own Apify account. A focused ~300-keyword run is forecast at about $3 to $7 (about $7 on Apify's free plan, less on paid plans; more at 1,000+ keywords), which EXCEEDS Apify's free monthly credit, so a card is required. The budget cap below (8.0) holds a default ~300-keyword run's forecast. The forecast prints the exact estimate before spending. This tool is not free.
_input_modes: Provide EITHER seed_terms (mode 1: keywords you already know) OR a vertical (mode 2: a market label to expand from). Set location for a city-localized SERP; leave it blank for country-level.
